headline: Daniel Franzen climbs to 25th on ARC-3

sections.text: Daniel Franzen gained 3.89 to reach 35.86, moving from 136th to 25th on the ARC-3 board.
The rise puts Franzen among ARC-3’s top 25 entries in the current public standings.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
